title: Qt: Move Keybord shortcuts to View->Internals and add print
description:
Moved the keyboard shortcuts from the about dialog to View->Internals and added a functionality to print the keyboard shortcuts.

Implements #15479

-menu:Help[About Wireshark,Keyboard Shortcuts] will show a list of all shortcuts

@@ -27,6 +27,8 @@ If you or your organization would like to contribute or become a sponsor, please
 // Many other improvements have been made.
 // See the “New and Updated Features” section below for more details.
 
+* The keyboard shortcuts dialog (About Wireshark → Keyboard Shortcuts) has been moved out of of the About dialog to the menu View → Internals → Keyboard Shortcuts and now has a button to print the list of keyboard shortcuts to an HTML file.
+
 The following changes have been made since version 0.9.3:
 
 * Stratoshark and strato can now read plain Kubernetes Audit logs and Google Cloud Audit logs, and CloudTrail logs.
